item.title: Former Peoria County prosecutor pleads guilty to weapons charge
item.description: Kali Pray, a former Peoria County assistant state's attorney, pleaded guilty to a felony weapons charge and was sentenced to two years of probation and 300 hours of community service.

item.title: Ken Burns guest curates America 250 exhibit at Peoria Riverfront Museum
item.description: The Peoria Riverfront Museum is set to unveil the "Promise of Liberty" exhibit, featuring 250 of the most important historical documents in the country, including the Declaration of Independence, Martin Luther King Jr.'s "I Have a Dream" speech, and the Emancipation Proclamation.

item.title: There’s a new leading cause of cancer death among people under 50, study finds
item.description: “We must double down on research to pinpoint what is driving this tsunami of cancer in generations born since 1950," the study's lead author said.

item.title: Former Prince Andrew can't escape Epstein's shadow as new documents reveal details about friendship
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Britain’s royal family is facing a fresh round of embarrassment after the latest release of documents from the U.S. investigation into Jeffrey Epstein revealed unsavory details about the relationship between the convicted sex offender and a correspondent who appears to be the man formerly known as Prince Andrew. item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Grady Demond Wilson dies at 79, according to reports
item.description: Grady Demond Wilson, best known for his role as Lamont Sanford on the sitcom "Sanford and Son," has died at age 79 due to complications related to cancer.

item.title: Judge orders 5-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and his dad released from ICE detention
item.description: A 5-year-old boy and his father must be released by Tuesday from the Texas center where they’ve been held after being detained by immigration officers in Minnesota, a federal judge ordered Saturday in a ruling that harshly criticized the Trump administration’s approach to enforcement. item.title: Peoria City Council to discuss settlement with Boyd Gaming over Par-A-Dice's location
item.description: The city of Peoria is considering a deal with the owners of the Par-A-Dice Casino Hotel to receive additional revenues in exchange for dropping its legal challenge to the casino's planned redevelopment.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly threatening to kill Bloomington officer during traffic stop
item.description: A man was arrested after threatening to kill a Bloomington police officer during a traffic stop, while a police dog search of the vehicle found cocaine in the center console.

item.title: Local leaders stuck on rooftop in Lacon to raise money for Hot Air Balloon Festival
item.description: The Lacon Chamber of Commerce hosted its first-ever Ransom on the Roof fundraiser, in which local business owners and community leaders raised money to come back down from a building, with the proceeds going to fund the Hot Air Balloon and Flight Festival.

item.title: Peoria County deputy suffers 'serious' injuries after being shot in South Peoria
item.description: A deputy with the Peoria County Sheriff's Office was shot in South Peoria late Saturday night and is in the hospital with serious injuries.
